scope: Evaluation of the user-supplied 20 statements, not an ISO certification

items.evidence: Actual timer start, route changes, reload, and a real one-minute presence deadline preserved the session and froze at 120 seconds in a three-minute fixture.
items.showcase: Start a three-minute timer with a one-minute presence interval. Switch pages, refresh, then show the automatic pause at 02:00.

items.evidence: Actual flashcard endpoint returned three cards. The real reflection UI returned sentiment feedback. Settled online browser runs had zero runtime exceptions and zero console errors.
items.showcase: Generate cards from the supplied biology notes; submit a short reflection; show the outputs and the Console.

items.evidence: Journal storage, same-ID updates, UTF-8 text, and retrieval passed. The journal is displayed in AI Coach, not as a reflection-log list in Analytics.
items.showcase: Show the reflection in AI Coach, reload, then show its cloud-backed retrieval. Correct the questionnaire location.

items.evidence: Ten actual client navigations completed in 66–276 ms for route shells. No runtime exceptions in the focused online run. This is a local short sample.
items.showcase: Use the app links between Dashboard, Cards, Coach, Analytics and Settings while the timer runs.

items.evidence: Analytics loaded with synthetic chart fixtures. JavaScript heap measured 6.32 to 7.55 MiB after ten navigations and garbage collection; this is not total browser memory or a long-term leak test.
items.showcase: Show Analytics plus a before/after Memory or browser Task Manager measurement; identify the measurement as a short sample.

items.evidence: The focused navigation capture recorded 20 API requests and 2043 encoded API bytes. Cached, in-flight and media responses are not a complete bandwidth budget. Audio asset cost remains separate.
items.showcase: In Network, separate Fetch/XHR from Media, compare transferred sizes, and disclose the media cost.

items.evidence: A different foreground Chromium tab did not lose timer progress. The one-minute presence pause still occurred, and audio continued in the focused retest. No broad OS-conflict certification was performed.
items.showcase: Open another tab for one minute, then return to the paused focus session.

items.evidence: Actual Gemini returned HTTP 200 in 1251 ms. Real flashcard generation and reflection submission also succeeded.
items.showcase: Show actual AI generation and a successful API response. Distinguish successful Gemini use from the app’s heuristic fallback.

items.evidence: Presence runs automatically while the browser remains able to execute it. QStash is not configured, so closed/suspended mobile-app delivery is not verified.
items.showcase: Leave the active browser session alone until presence pauses automatically. Do not promise locked-phone delivery.

items.evidence: All five main routes were reachable through real in-app links. Whether users find navigation clear requires participant observation, not automation alone.
items.showcase: Ask a classmate to open Cards, start Timer, find Coach, then open Analytics without coaching them.

items.evidence: All five main routes fit 1440, 390 and 320 CSS-pixel viewports after authentication and data settled. All four Settings categories also fit without horizontal overflow.
items.showcase: Open Settings at desktop width and 320 px. Switch all four categories and show that no horizontal scroll is needed.

items.evidence: Regular online navigation, AI use, reload and timer checks completed without unexpected runtime exceptions in the final runs. Long-duration stability remains unmeasured. Complete offline navigation is outside the intended product scope.
items.showcase: Run a short normal-use sequence, then separately disclose the offline navigation issue and remaining soak test.

items.evidence: An online-started timer retained a connection restore point, queued its completion during a temporary disconnection, and saved exactly one accepted record after reconnection. Full offline use and every interrupted editing workflow are outside this check.
items.showcase: Start a one-minute timer while online. After Start reaches the server, temporarily disconnect near completion. Reconnect and show one saved record. Describe this as connection recovery, not offline mode.

items.evidence: The same audio element continued across actual in-app navigation and another foreground tab, advancing from about 0.003 to 2.475 seconds. Physical-device suspension and actual OS minimization remain untested; reload may require another play gesture.
items.showcase: Start audio with a user click, navigate using app links, switch tabs, and return. Do not equate this with all phone lock-screen behavior.

items.evidence: Five private endpoints rejected unauthenticated access (401); wrong password was rejected (401); another account could not read/delete a deck (404); student admin access was denied (403). Session header A256GCM and HttpOnly plus bcrypt storage were verified without recording a token.
items.showcase: Show failed login, two isolated test accounts, and redacted session/encryption configuration. Do not display actual cookie values.

items.evidence: Basic duration integrity passed: fabricated 900-second, forged-timestamp and batch requests returned 422 with zero fabricated rows; incoming private-clock edits were ignored. Real server-timed saves worked, retries created one row, and another account could not claim that timer. This is not proof of attention.
items.showcase: Start and save a genuine timer. Show one resulting record, then show that a fabricated 900-second request is rejected and a repeated valid save does not create a duplicate.

items.evidence: Shared modules and API routes are separated. The 59-test suite, production build, Prisma validation and scoped lint for the new helpers passed. Full source lint still reports 59 errors and 19 warnings, matching the preexisting baseline.
items.showcase: Show the module structure and build, and retain the code-quality finding for technical review.

items.evidence: Prisma schema validation passed. Real deck/card/session storage and retrieval worked; declared user/deck/card/session relationships and cascades were inspected. Journal data currently lives inside a telemetry JSON field.
items.showcase: Show User → Deck → Card and User/Deck → StudySession relationships, using only dummy records.

items.evidence: All five actual pages fit 1440, 390 and 320 CSS-pixel Chromium viewports with no horizontal overflow. Real iPhone/Android, Safari and Firefox testing remains necessary for device-specific claims.
items.showcase: Demonstrate the desktop and phone-sized layouts. Repeat the key flow on an actual Android and iPhone before claiming physical-device compatibility.

items.evidence: A real browser login form and all main routes worked in the local production build without installing a client application. The development/test tools are not requirements for end users.
items.showcase: Open the deployed HTTPS URL in a normal browser and sign in. Explain that Home Screen installation is optional for basic web access.

retestResolution.audio: The broad script attempted to open the Dashboard audio widget while on Settings. That harness timeout is superseded by retest-followup.json, which uses the actual Dashboard and passes.
retestResolution.connection: The final broad run and the final 10-second online-started repair fixture both passed. An earlier 5-second wait timeout is retained as test history, not counted as a successful run.
retestResolution.layout: Both settled full-route checks and the four-category Settings repair checks passed at 320, 390 and 1440 px.
retestResolution.scope: Connection restore points only; complete offline navigation is not an implemented product claim.

cleanup: All temporary evaluation users and associated records were removed; no real student records were edited.
